overall_assessment: acceptable: the changed tests align with real contract behavior and use effective layered proof—unit, real PostgreSQL/BFF, protocol-bound fake provider, and fresh served-browser coverage. No pass-the-test shortcut, test-only product route, silent fallback, focused/skip bypass, or assertion-only-on-status pattern is evidenced. Test-first evidence is partial but honestly bounded; the current causal regressions are distinguished from post-implementation coverage.
recommended_path: proceed_to_remaining_independent_review_and_delivery_gates; do not represent the candidate as delivered until DOD-11, DOD-12, DOD-13, runtime activation, operator proof, and canonical diff-guard requirements have their required evidence.

findings.title: Delivery-only runtime and operator proof remains intentionally outstanding
findings.rationale: E54 binds a terminal full suite to the current sealed source and demonstrates real disposable PostgreSQL/BFF/served-browser behavior, but its external boundary is an owned fake. It cannot establish preserved-runtime migration/image provenance, a real approved-template first send, nonofficial first send, or recipient replies. The package explicitly retains these as DOD-11 through DOD-13 gates.
findings.suggested_action: Keep these gates pending and collect their separately authorized evidence without weakening the current synthetic test claims.
